title: Case V: If DB Has a Black Sibling With a Black Far Child and Red Near Child

blocks.content: Case V: If DB Has a Black Sibling With a Black Far Child and Red Near Child
If the DB has a black sibling whose far child is black and the near child is red, we must apply the steps below to convert this problem to resemble Case IV:

items: Swap the color of the sibling and its near child.
Rotate the sibling towards the far child.
Treat this as a new problem of Case IV.
